root_cause.text: The driver's interrupt URB completion handler did not validate the received URB length before interpreting the data, allowing a short (truncated) URB to cause out-of-bounds access or processing of invalid data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an explicit length check `if (urb->actual_length < sizeof(*data)) { ... goto resubmit_urb; }` to ensure the URB contains at least the expected data structure size before any processing occurs.
